content.ascii:
terminal_stream: Termio-owned Stream(StreamHandler)
|
|-- parser: terminal.Parser (src/terminal/Parser.zig)
|   |-- VT state + parameters/intermediates
|   `-- osc_parser: OSC parsing and payload state
|-- utf8decoder: incremental UTF-8 decode state
|-- handler: owned StreamHandler (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|   |-- apc: multipart handler (Kitty graphics)
|   |-- dcs: multipart handler (e.g. XTGETTCAP)
|   |-- kitty_clipboard_grants + optional in-flight write transaction
|   |-- Optional tmux_viewer (compile-time gated)
|   |-- terminal: borrowed &Termio.terminal
|   |   `-- Handler actions -> mutate modes / Screens / pages
|   |-- termio_mailbox: borrowed queue + termio_messaged flag
|   |   `-- Protocol replies -> Termio mailbox -> PTY write path
|   |-- surface_mailbox: routing handle, not an owned Surface
|   |   `-- -> App.mailbox -> hasSurface -> main-thread Surface.handleMessage
|   |-- renderer_state / renderer_mailbox / renderer_wakeup: shared links
|   |   `-- queueRender() -> renderer wakeup; no direct native UI calls
|   `-- size + configuration references/settings
|-- nextSlice(bytes) (src/terminal/stream.zig)
|   `-- UTF-8 / VT decoding -> handler actions
`-- deinit(): parser + handler deinit; release multipart/clipboard state
